description: Cancel one order (order_id) or all your orders in a pool, and withdraw settled amounts into your BalanceManager. Returns UNSIGNED tx bytes (simulated against mainnet). Non-custodial: the desk never sees or holds keys and never moves funds; it returns quotes and UNSIGNED transactions only. Spot only, no leverage. Education only, not financial advice.

balance_manager_id.description: YOUR DeepBook BalanceManager id (0x + 64 hex), from build_create_balance_manager_tx effects

sender.description: YOUR Sui address (0x...). Public address only; never send a key.

name: build_cancel_order_tx
title: Build: cancel DeepBook order(s)
